limits.summary: Each shard supports up to 1 MB/s or 1000 records/s writes and 2 MB/s reads; single-shard streams serialize throughput.
Polling consumers (GetRecords) share the shard's 2 MB/s read budget; multiple consumers contend without enhanced fan-out.
Enhanced fan-out gives each registered consumer its own 2 MB/s per shard via SubscribeToShard.
Default retention is 24 hours (up to 8760h); lagging consumers lose records permanently at expiry. IteratorAgeMilliseconds is the runtime signal.
